about: Touhou Kobuto V: Burst Battle is a bullet-hell battle game that takes place in the Touhou universe. Take control of one of nine Touhou characters and eliminate your opponent using bullet-hell patterns, melee attacks, or spell cards!
Remote Play requires PS Vita system and sufficiently robust Wi-Fi connection.
Network Players 2-2 - Full game requires PlayStation®Plus membership to access online multiplayer
Licensed to and published by NIS America, Inc.
